SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id_student) FROM studentAssessment AS t1 JOIN assessments AS t2 ON t1.id_assessment = t2.id_assessment JOIN studentInfo AS t3 ON t1.id_student = t3.id_student AND t2.code_module = t3.code_module AND t2.code_presentation = t3.code_presentation WHERE t2.assessment_type = 'Exam' AND t1.score < 40 AND t3.final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction')
